# Research Peptide Blend Calculator

> Browser-based laboratory calculator for research peptide work: concentration, blend ratios, reconstitution volume and dilution, with the arithmetic shown step by step.

## Tool
- [Calculator](https://2026peptide-calculator.vercel.app/): Peptide concentration and blend calculator for laboratory use.

## Notes
- For research and laboratory use only — not for human or veterinary administration.
- All calculations run in the browser; no input is transmitted.
